notes.title: Summer Update (2) - Beers, Tutorial, and improvements!
notes.content:
Welcome back, everyone! Hope you are enjoying the summer. We have a new game made by Business Goose, we've added a tutorial section (supported by the community), and added several improvements.

[h2]Tutorial[/h2]

[h3]Sab016 made a helpful tutorial[/h3]

Since StreamAlertsTV is now featured in the Twitch Extension Store, more creators are discovering it every day. To make sure they get the most out of it, we're building a library of community tips and tricks.

We're kicking things off with a tutorial, but that's just the start. If you've created a clever way to use StreamAlertsTV, whether it's a unique alert design or a content idea that boosted engagement, share your video with us. We'll feature it so other creators can discover and learn from your approach.

[h2]Hold My Beer - Cheers to the Creators[/h2]

[h3]A new disruption in collaboration with Business Goose[/h3]

"Hey, man, hold my beer. Check this out:" the classic words that end in either awesomeness or injury. If you're on Reddit, the subreddit holdmybeer (HMB) is a page filled with epic wins and fails.

[i]Hold My Beer[/i] is much like that.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057817/d58fc57907fd1257be22722763ce49e7c54a96ce.gif[/img]

[i]Hold My Beer[/i] lets your viewers order a beer, you tap it, and serve it! Do your best, you don't want to make a mess around the studio now.

It's a short, chaotic disruption. It layers [i]on top[/i] of the game you're playing. Think: you're tapping a beer while trying to beat the final boss. Of course, your viewers will pick the [i]worst[/i] possible moment, so it's literally an HMB-worthy clip.

Serve the perfect beer when viewers use Bits-in-Extension, Cheers, channel points, and, in the future, charity donations.

So: Cheers, Proost, Santé, and Salute! We hope you enjoy [i]Hold My Beer[/i] responsibly.

notes.title: Spring Update (1) - The Wheel of Misfortune!
notes.content:
Through collaboration with [url=https://www.businessgoose.be/]Business Goose[/url] we’ve created two new games that are available for everyone. The Wheel of Misfortune and Cat-and-Mouse. Here is how they work:

[h2]Spin the wheel![/h2]

[previewyoutube=rKNVz4CwrUg;full][/previewyoutube]


Have your viewers spin the wheel, and fortune might be on your side. The outcome is random, but the wheel is full of shenanigans.

Here is what's important to know:
[list]
[*] You can create multiple wheels with different outcomes
[*] The wheel can be changed to fit your channel's branding
[/list]

[h3]EEYK! More games? Nani!?[/h3]

Business Goose made the classic Cat-and-Mouse game with a funny twist. Escape the cats' claws and survive!

[b]What else?[/b] We have alerts and games, but some ideas we have fall in between. We believe they will eventually be called Power Ups. We don’t have to wait until Twitch enables this. The wheel can be great for experimenting with disruptions, such as filling up the entire screen with frogs or very loud airhorns. What? AIRHORNS! You will find out. Give the wheel a spin and share a clip when you do. 

Jump into our [url=https://discord.com/invite/FpEV3JDRDU]Discord[/url] to share your ideas!

notes.title: Winter update (8) Extension + free content!
notes.content:
Twitch Extension improvements, jump scares, and wholesome rainbows with even more content cooking! This is a short update to prepare for new games we are making together with Business Goose.

[h2]Extension update[/h2]

[url=https://dashboard.twitch.tv/extensions/7teba0pfkswid7g704x5dqsojt3w26]Screen Alerts[/url] is a dedicated Twitch Extension that helps you earn money with StreamAlertsTV. Through bits-in-extension features, your viewers can make disruptions appear on your screen. Here is what we worked on:

[list]
[*] The Extension chatbot will help you with written viewer notifications in the chat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057817/e0d1928038fdd15b5a47d616b358bb924b6fc8f8.png[/img]

[*] More UI improvements with various new icons.
[/list]

The extension should get more attention, because Twitch recently announced monetization will be available from day 1 for all content creators.


[h3]Free content[/h3]

We added a Jump Scares with a Glitch effect, but also a wholesome Heart animation with a Rainbow Trail. You know, perfectly balanced, as all things should be. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057817/276a79a7e2c7beb8c37ebac62446f04553c32153.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057817/dccf92fa287b966f9be19f39ad275e4ec6cebdbc.gif[/img]

The content is free, and available to try it out! Share your clips with jump scares, or wholesome content in our Discord 💜

[h3]Collaboration announcement![/h3]

We are producing 2 new games with Business Goose, the company that created Sizeable, 30 Birds, and is currently working on the puzzle game Swan Song.

[h4]Releasing this month:[/h4]

[b]Wheel of Misfortune[/b] is a spin-the-wheel mechanic that randomizes the next disruption. This wheel can be customized to your channels’ branding. 

[b]Cat-and-Mouse[/b] is a classic game with an innovative twist. The cats are out to get you and it’s up to you to escape their paws. 

This is not our first time working together. We produced Break Games and worked on various ad campaigns. 

Get into our [url=https://discord.com/invite/FpEV3JDRDU]Discord[/url] if you’d like access to the Beta and help us test the games before they launch.

notes.title: Winter update (2) Shop Update!
notes.content:
We are starting the new year with an exciting shop update! You can now purchase single objects. We are working on ways to expand the shop by adding animations and VFX effects. 

Furthermore, we are sharing the upcoming updates we are now working on, including our experimental ambitions.🧪


[h2]Upcoming content[/h2]

[list]
[*] Get ready for some adorable jumping frogs! This bundle is planned for next week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057817/a4310d319540972f7ae1fbca4134a0f25db70667.png[/img]

[*] Lunar New Year will also get its own bundle! Here's a sneak peek.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45057817/2308066a927c4f40ea12b6501a647a181abf9ea4.png[/img]

[/list]

[h2]Experimental ambitions, exploring the unknown.[/h2]
There is an unstoppable ambition to discover our technical limits and increase our creative potential. Therefore we always want to explore. After achieving a significant breakthrough, we want to bring these opportunities to creators. 

[b]Lights Out![/b] is a good example. The game was relatively simple, and technically a giant milestone that gained us a lot of knowledge. While we are polishing Lights Out!, our next step, is to see what else can we do. So here are some upcoming experimental projects:
[list]
[*] [b]Bomb Squad[/b] - Your devious viewers want you to dismantle a bomb. 
[*] [b]Balloon Pop[/b] - Shoot those balloons as quickly as you can. 
[/list]
Both games focus on making objects clickable. They are quick and potentially disruptive. Not resolving the bomb puzzle, or shooting the wrong balloon, will have consequences. 

Sounds cool? Do you have any ideas/suggestions for your community? You might want to start following our Twitch channel [url=https://www.twitch.tv/pando_dev]Pando_Dev[/url]. We are trying out new features live on this channel, and we need your help to test! Hope to see you there! 


If you have suggestions, leave a comment here or join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/FpEV3JDRDU]Discord! [/url]

notes.title: Autumn update!
notes.content:
Welcome to our first update! After last week's release, we have received helpful feedback to resolve bugs. Thankfully they were limited to only a small number, allowing us to focus on new content! Learn what's new in our patch notes. 

[previewyoutube=BKExshALTl8;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]New features and content[/h2]

[list]
[*] We now support alerts for incoming Raids!
[*] Get an Autumn look! Thanksgiving now includes VFX; feathers, leaves, and potatoes! 
[*] Viewers can obscure your vision with a Smoke explosion (available for free!) 
[*] Get in early, and start celebrating Christmas! Check out the bundle in the shop!
[*] You can now change the spawn delay to increase the time between the objects appearing on the screen!
[/list]


[h3]Minor changes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a connection problem with the overlay during long streams (8 hours)
[*] Default settings for gifted subs show the #gifter in the center text, and #Receiver when the object explodes.
[*] UI improvement to understand which VFX Trails and Bursts support custom colors. 
[*] Improvements to interactions with new subscribers and returning subscribers with added messages. 
[*] We renamed Animation to Behavior
[/list]

The next festive update will be ready later this month. It will include an important improvement as we integrate chat interactions!

[list]
[*] Christmas Ornaments Bundle
[*] Christmas VFX (snowfall, and much more!)
[*] Chat Interactions (new chatter, chat commands, emotes)
[*] Shout Out Interaction
[/list]
